en-US.author: Myst1024
en-US.description: Mute background applications while keeping foreground audio active
en-US.longDescription: BackgroundMute automatically mutes audio from background processes while preserving sound from the active window. Useful for gaming, streaming, or focusing on a single application without audio interference.
en-US.name: BackgroundMute
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Fixed bugs that occurred when switching output devices
- Fixed bugs that occurred when apps closed unexpectedly
- Fixed app icon
- Fixed GUI taskbar functionality
